stemMd: How many three-digit positive integers have all digits odd, allowing repetition?
explanationMd: Each position has five choices: 1,3,5,7,9. None is zero, so the leading position needs no special restriction. Multiply $5^3=125$.

distractorRationale.a: Forbids repetition even though it is allowed.
distractorRationale.d: Uses six choices in one position.
